ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile web tool using lightweight computer vision to detect early crop stress and predict yield using localized historical soil data.
ideas.title: AgriCrop-AI Field Yield & Stress Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a high-impact local agrarian region need while keeping model inference lightweight enough to run reliably on edge devices during a live offline demo.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage app providing offline-first rPPG heart rate estimation and multi-language patient intake summaries for resource-constrained clinics.
ideas.title: MediScan-Rural Triage & Health Vault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs hard engineering through rPPG camera-based vital sensing, delivering a working live demo that heavily impresses health tech judges.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent personalized learning platform using local RAG to help students navigate curriculum documents and automatically generate adaptive practice quizzes.
ideas.title: EdGraph AI Student Support System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a proven multi-agent RAG architecture that won top honors at similar educational innovation hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An automated algorithmic decision auditor that flags bias and regulatory discrepancies in automated financial loan approvals using explainable multi-agent rules.
ideas.title: FinAudit Compliance Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages an advanced algorithmic bias auditing framework that aligns with rigorous compliance judging criteria.

ideas.pitch: An integrated hardware-software dashboard tracking local industrial machine vibrations and power consumption for automated maintenance alerts.
ideas.title: AutoRoute IoT Smart Factory Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a tangible end-to-end hardware simulation with a polished real-time web dashboard, ensuring a striking live demo.
